name: – Ondřej Kolář – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on Bosnia and Herzegovina's progress towards joining the European Union. It asks the country's leaders to stop blocking reforms, pass overdue laws on courts and judges, and fight corruption. It wants a chief negotiator appointed and more EU money released only when clear reform steps are met. It also calls for action against secessionist rhetoric, foreign disinformation, attacks on journalists, and discrimination, and for better energy, environment and transport policy.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament gives its opinion and asks for reforms, laws and a chief negotiator.
- **Who it affects:** Bosnia and Herzegovina's politicians, courts, media and citizens, plus EU institutions.
- **What happens next:** EU funds and accession talks depend on the country meeting the listed reform steps.
